source_and_installed_records.source_Japanese:
その艦隊は赤字です。艦隊の借金を
返済できるほどの所持金がありません！
source_and_installed_records.installed_text: Trade-good description. Review its use, origin, and value.

source_review.english: This fleet is operating at a loss. You can't afford to pay its debt.

source_and_installed_records.source_Japanese:
このデータはフェアデータです
ゲームを中断すると
データは失われますが
よろしいですか？
source_and_installed_records.installed_text: This is exhibition data. Ｉf you quit the game, the data will be lost. Proceed?

source_review.english: You will lose this exhibition data if you quit. Quit anyway?

source_and_installed_records.source_Japanese: 本当にやり直すのかい？

source_review.english: Are you sure you want to start over?

source_and_installed_records.source_Japanese: 忙しいんだから、冗談は勘弁してくんな
source_and_installed_records.installed_text: I'm busy. Don't waste my time.

source_review.english: I'm busy. Spare me the jokes.
